title: macOS code selection lag in the Godot editor
body: I can reproduce this in Godot 4.4 stable and every version from 4.3-beta1 onward, but not in 4.3-dev6 or earlier. On macOS Sequoia 15.3.2 on a Mac Studio M1 Ultra, there is a delay between clicking in the code editor and moving the pointer to select text, making selections imprecise and random. Disabling V-Sync and enabling Update Continuously appeared to correct it.

symptoms_visible: There is a delay between when I click in the Godot code editor and when I move the pointer, so text selection is imprecise and appears random.
N0.label: N0 code selection lag reported

symptoms_visible: Text selection still lags in Forward+ and Mobile after disabling V-Sync and enabling Update Continuously.
In Compatibility mode, the lag disappears only when V-Sync is disabled and Update Continuously is enabled.
The lag remained after I completely removed Logitech Options+.
N1_x.label: N1_x rendering-settings workaround aftermath

symptoms_visible: In macOS Safe Mode, text selection works smoothly in every Godot configuration I tried.
N2.label: N2 Safe Mode probe succeeds

symptoms_visible: After returning to a normal boot, the code-selection lag came back.
I do not see the selection lag in other editors, and changing V-Sync, Single Window Mode, or Update Continuously individually does not remove it.
N3.label: N3 normal-startup software involvement established

symptoms_visible: After I quit Magnet, text selection in Godot no longer lags.
N4.label: N4 Magnet interaction isolated

symptoms_visible: Magnet can remain running if I select its Ignore Godot option; with that exclusion active, the code-selection lag is gone.
N5.label: N5 per-application exclusion verified

symptoms_visible: Code selection in Godot is smooth with Magnet configured to ignore Godot; Magnet can remain open and the lag no longer occurs.
N_terminal.label: terminal resolved with Magnet exclusion

solution.intent: Treat the editor's rendering cadence as the cause and use disabled V-Sync together with continuous updating as the general fix.
solution.concrete_example: Disable V-Sync and enable Update Continuously in the Editor Settings, then restart Godot.

edges.comment: Opening report and reporter c2: the apparent V-Sync/continuous-update workaround was not sufficient in Forward+ or Mobile. The reporter also removed Logitech Options+ without changing the symptom. The changed editor settings are represented as state S1b.

question_patterns: Could you boot macOS in Safe Mode and report whether text selection still lags?
Please test Godot during a Safe Mode session and tell me what you observe.
clarifications.user_answer_in_this_oncall: I booted in Safe Mode, and everything worked flawlessly in every configuration I tried.

counterfactual_candidates.answer: The same selection lag still occurs in Safe Mode.
Safe Mode is smooth in Forward+ and Compatibility, but I did not test Mobile.

edges.comment: Reporter c7 and c13: Safe Mode consistently removed the symptom. This is a temporary diagnostic boot and therefore a measurement, not a persistent system-state change.

question_patterns: After testing Safe Mode, can you restart normally and check whether the behavior returns?
Does the improvement persist in a normal macOS session?
clarifications.user_answer_in_this_oncall: After one restart it briefly continued to work, but after the Mac had been off overnight the problem returned. Safe Mode was smooth again, and the following normal boot still had the lag.

counterfactual_candidates.answer: The lag stayed gone through repeated normal boots and has not returned.

question_patterns: Does text selection show the same delay in another editor such as Visual Studio Code?
Can you reproduce the input delay outside Godot?
clarifications.user_answer_in_this_oncall: No. I cannot reproduce it in Visual Studio Code or other applications; it happens in Godot.

counterfactual_candidates.answer: Yes, every editor and application has the same pointer delay.

question_patterns: What happens when you test the relevant editor display options one at a time and restart where required?
Do any of the individual editor-window or refresh settings eliminate the issue by themselves?
clarifications.user_answer_in_this_oncall: The lag is still present with V-Sync disabled, with Single Window Mode enabled, or with Update Continuously enabled individually. I only avoid it with the full Compatibility-mode combination.

edges.comment: Reporter c8 and c12-c17: the normal-session symptom returned, other editors were unaffected, and Calinou's controlled editor-setting questions did not identify an individual setting that fixed it.

question_patterns: Since Safe Mode suppresses login software, can you quit your normally running window-management or input-related utilities one at a time and report what changes?
Could you test the background applications that do not load in Safe Mode and tell me whether stopping any one of them changes Godot's behavior?
clarifications.user_answer_in_this_oncall: I quit Magnet, and that solved the problem. The code-selection lag disappeared.

counterfactual_candidates.answer: I quit every background and window-management utility, including Magnet, and the lag remained unchanged.
Quitting an unrelated menu-bar clock changed nothing, but I did not test the window-management applications.

edges.comment: Discovery originated with affected user SNelson81 in c28 and was confirmed by reporter fantomac in c30; affected users are folded into one simulated user side. The question remains generic and does not reveal which third-party application will prove relevant.

question_patterns: Can you test whether a narrower per-application configuration also avoids the lag, and report exactly what you changed?
Is it possible to leave the implicated utility running while excluding only the affected application? Please test and report the result.
clarifications.user_answer_in_this_oncall: Yes. I focused Godot, opened Magnet's dropdown, and clicked “Ignore Godot.” Magnet can stay open and there are no more issues.

counterfactual_candidates.answer: The per-application exclusion makes no difference; only fully quitting the utility removes the lag.
The exclusion works after restarting Godot, but not until then.

edges.comment: Reporter c30: the reporter verified the narrower per-application exclusion and attached the Magnet menu screenshot. This is a handler-evaluated configuration probe upstream of the recommendation.

solution.intent: Avoid the third-party Magnet interaction by configuring Magnet to ignore Godot, or quit Magnet if a per-application exclusion is unavailable, then verify that selection remains smooth under normal Godot settings.
solution.concrete_example: With Godot focused, open Magnet's menu and choose “Ignore Godot.” Alternatively, quit Magnet while using Godot. Restore the normal Godot renderer and refresh settings and confirm that text selection remains responsive.
solution.inference_hint: The reporter supplied the raw contrasts: smooth in Safe Mode, lag after normal startup, smooth after quitting Magnet, and smooth when Magnet ignores Godot. Connecting those observations to a third-party Magnet/Godot interaction rather than mouse hardware or Godot's renderer settings is the diagnostic inference. The thread does not establish a deeper event-propagation mechanism.

edges.comment: Reporter c30 confirmed both quitting Magnet and using Magnet's Ignore Godot option. Other affected users confirmed normal settings and Forward+ were smooth afterward. Maintainer c39 consolidated the issue because it appeared caused by the third-party Magnet application; no Godot code fix was established in this thread.

solution.intent: Check for the known third-party Magnet interaction immediately, configure Magnet to ignore Godot or quit it, and have the user verify that text selection is smooth with normal Godot settings.
solution.concrete_example: If Magnet is running, focus Godot and choose “Ignore Godot” from Magnet's menu, or quit Magnet temporarily. Retest code selection with the normal renderer and update settings before declaring the issue resolved.

edges.comment: Shortcut from the opening state so an agent that already knows the accepted resolution can propose it without first repeating the falsified renderer-settings workaround. User verification is still required.

satisfaction_conditions: Must identify the final accepted cause as an interaction between Godot and the third-party Magnet window-management application; the thread does not establish a more specific event-propagation mechanism.
Diagnosis must be grounded in the observed contrasts: the lag disappears in Safe Mode, returns after a normal boot, and disappears when Magnet is quit or configured to ignore Godot.

Must recommend configuring Magnet to ignore Godot, or quitting Magnet while using Godot, rather than treating Logitech software, mouse hardware, V-Sync, Update Continuously, or the renderer as the root cause.
Must not present disabled V-Sync plus Update Continuously as the complete fix: it was unreliable in Forward+ and Mobile and imposed unnecessary continuous resource usage.
Must have the user verify smooth text selection with Magnet excluded from Godot before treating the issue as resolved.

persona_hint.experience_level: Experienced Godot user who can compare engine versions and renderers, modify editor settings, remove background utilities, boot macOS in Safe Mode, and perform controlled configuration tests.
persona_hint.communication_style: Friendly, concise, and cooperative; reports configuration matrices clearly, follows troubleshooting requests, and expresses uncertainty when behavior changes unexpectedly.
